name: Quicksilver Cloak
text:
This featherlight cloak seems to reflect the very essence of the day star, granting you a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against light effects.

Activate—Slide Through 1 (attack, concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
Effect Staring down the creature before you, you center your shot, shooting it through one of the silver spheres floating about you. Make a ranged Strike against an enemy. The attack is treated as silver.
